subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The outcome document of the Rio + 20 Conference, the Future We Want, underscores climate change as "an __inevitable__ and urgent global challenge with long-term implications for the sustainable development of all countries". Through the document, Member States express their concern about the continuous rising of emissions of greenhouse gases and the vulnerability of all countries, particularly developing countries, to the adverse impacts of climate change.
solution:
The correct answer is: **undeniable**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Synonym of "inevitable" is "undeniable".
 
• "**Undeniable**" means something that cannot be denied or disputed. (कुछ ऐसा जिसे नकारा या विवादित नहीं किया जा सकता)
 
 
• **For example**: *The evidence presented was undeniable, proving his innocence.*
 
 
 
• The sentence suggests that climate change is a global challenge that cannot be disputed.
 
• Grammatically, "undeniable" is an adjective that modifies the noun "global challenge".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Immemorable **means something that cannot be remembered. It is not a synonym of the underlined word. (कुछ ऐसा जो याद न रखा जा सके)
 
• **Adventurous **means something that involves risk or excitement. It is not a synonym of the underlined word. (कुछ ऐसा जिसमें जोखिम या उत्तेजना शामिल हो)
 
• **Escapable **means something that can be avoided or evaded. It is the opposite of the underlined word. (कुछ ऐसा जिसे टाला जा सकता है)
